snippet.title: Rhythm Hotel - New Trailer and Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
Rhythm Hotel is a rhythm game bursting with wildly unpredictable, absurdly hilarious storylines. 
The game demo on Steam is available now. Download and play it now. If you enjoy it, please add it to your wishlist.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253930/Rhythm_Hotel/

Join our Discord
https://discord.gg/ENet75YjE7
